causal_witness_raw.intermediate: The selected rectangle's input-derived matrix coordinates, bounds, and area.
causal_witness_raw.step_a: Parse the complete green-divider lattice and select its unique largest zero rectangle.
causal_witness_raw.step_b: Use that selected coordinate to fill the pivot 7, its other row/column regions 0, and the four quadrants 2/4/1/8, preserving dividers.
causal_witness_raw.why_b_depends_on_a: The selected coordinates determine each region's quadrant or axis; moving the unique largest rectangle changes later color choices at unchanged matrix indices.

limitations: Two seeds and finite declared rivals only. No universal identifiability, broad seed census, measured learning benefit, or native acceptance is claimed. Tallest-row/widest-column factorization is mathematically equivalent to largest area on this grammar.

         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((div-rows (for/list ((r (range 0 h)) #:when
                                (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              r))
                  (div-cols (for/list ((c (range 0 w)) #:when
                                (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r c) 3)))
                              c))
                  (row-bounds (append (list -1) div-rows (list h)))
                  (col-bounds (append (list -1) div-cols (list w)))
                  (row-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs row-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (col-ranges (filter (lambda (p) (<= (first p) (second p)))
                                      (let loop
                                           ((bs col-bounds))
                                           (if (null? (cdr bs))
                                               (list)
                                               (cons (list (+ (car bs) 1)
                                                           (- (cadr bs) 1))
                                                     (loop (cdr bs)))))))
                  (nr (length row-ranges))
                  (nc (length col-ranges))
                  (result (make-hash)))
             (for* ((r (range 0 h)) (c (range 0 w)))
                   (hash-set! result (list r c) (at g r c)))
             (for ((ri (range 0 nr)))
               (for ((ci (range 0 nc)))
                 (let* ((rr (list-ref row-ranges ri))
                        (cr (list-ref col-ranges ci))
                        (clr (cond
                               ((and (zero? ri) (zero? ci)) 2)
                               ((and (zero? ri) (= ci (- nc 1))) 4)
                               ((and (= ri (- nr 1)) (zero? ci)) 8)
                               ((and (= ri (- nr 1)) (= ci (- nc 1))) 1)
                               ((and (> ri 0) (< ri (- nr 1)) (> ci 0) (< ci (- nc 1))) 7)
                               (else 0))))
                   (for* ((r (range (first rr) (+ (second rr) 1))) (c (range (first cr) (+ (second cr) 1))))
                         (hash-set! result (list r c) clr)))))
             (cellmap g (r c v) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))
